wardrobe:
Everyone changes clothes between the arrival and dinner, so the change shows on screen.

MILA
- Arrival (M1, M2): a long sleeveless knit dress in faded denim blue, the colour of her eyes (#082). It is body-skimming, "hugging her body like a second breath" (#082, brand removed), with a high side slit. She wears strappy heels, and her scratched gold bangle is her only jewellery. This replaces the black off-shoulder dress in her cast portrait, so the reference outfit never reaches the screen.
- Body (written into M1 and M2): "a healthy model's body, fuller than in her reference: toned arms, soft curves, long shapely legs, slender, not skinny." The sleeveless cut and the slit show the healthy body instead of hiding it.
- Dinner (M3, M4, M5): UNCHANGED. She keeps the approved white silk-and-lace dress with thin straps. She has kicked off her shoes and is barefoot (#083), and the white heeled sandals lie kicked off in M5. Heels at the arrival and bare feet at dinner are a visible change in themselves.
- Colour arc: faded blue at the jetty, then white at dinner, then pure ultramarine pouring off the white (M4), then a ghost in white (M5). Her colour gets purer as she leaves ("too pure, undiluted by turpentine", #083).
- Risks: (1) Her approved cast portrait is gaunt. If Seedream keeps the bony body despite "fuller than in her reference", the fix is a new Mila reference with a healthy body. That needs Elena's OK first, because the portrait was approved. (2) The approved M4 and M5 still show the thinner legs. They stay as approved. If Elena wants the same body there, it is a short edit on those stills.

JEAN-MARC
- Arrival (M1, M2), a bohemian art collector with crypto money: an unstructured deep-emerald crushed silk-velvet jacket worn open, over a loose silk shirt with a blurred painterly print in ochre and rust (a Gauguin palette), open on his chest, plus layered gold chains and heavy rings on several fingers. Left out of the prompts for length; add them if a take allows: loose ink-black trousers, suede loafers, bare ankles. No watch (her no-watches rule), no sunglasses, no brands, logos or text.
- Why emerald: it is the colour of the diamond-and-emerald "advance" Ule closes on Kira's throat in 14, so the "two owners of exclusive stuff" (#083) share one jewel colour. It also keeps oxblood and crimson out of section IV, because crimson belongs to section VI in the Law 5 colour chain. And emerald and faded blue are the cool opposites of the copper light, so the copper glows, as it does on an Impressionist canvas.
- Dinner (M3, M4): UNCHANGED. He keeps the approved white linen shirt open on his chest and one thin gold chain. The velvet, print and rings come off, so the collector is stripped down to a man who owes ("a drowning man", M4).
- Quality check: his cast reference wears white linen, so reject any jetty take where he is still in white.

KIRA (continuity only): a thin black silk strap at the jetty (M1, M2), then THAT jungle-print silk dress (13, 14, M5), then a black silk slip (15 as approved in k15, and 30), then the crimson silk sheet (31). #086 puts her "in her Jungle Dress" on the rain night, but the approved k15 shows the black slip, so the black slip stays.

ULE: white linen in 15 (damp, open at the collar), 30 (open collar) and 31 (open on the chest). The spare version of 15 adds his faded blue jeans (#086), only if 15 is ever re-rendered.

shots.prompt: Unretouched 35mm film still, 16:9, real skin, muted film colour; the people not painted, not HDR. Copper afternoon, a wooden jetty in a black-sand bay, a storm front low, a white seaplane behind. Walking toward us, the woman from the second reference image, same face, ash-blonde hair scraped back, a healthy model's body fuller than in her reference: toned arms, soft curves, long shapely legs, slender, not skinny; a long sleeveless knit dress in faded denim blue, clinging like a second breath, high side slit, strappy heels. Beside her the man from the third reference image, same face, dreadlocks tied half-up, beard, broad shoulders, a rich bohemian collector: open deep-emerald crushed-velvet jacket over a loose ochre-and-rust printed silk shirt, open on his chest, layered gold chains, heavy rings; his flat palm on her waist, eyes ahead. Left foreground, soft, from behind: the head and one bare shoulder, black strap, of the woman from the first reference image, true-black wavy hair, watching. One impossible thing, treated as normal: behind the sharp photographic people, the air, sky and sea thicken into wet, unblended oil-paint strokes of copper, rose and cadmium, like paint on a palette before the first stroke. No text, no logos.
shots.other_reality: Her own line from this very landing, "The air between us thickens like oil paint on a palette before the first stroke" (#082), becomes the atmosphere. Behind three photographic people, the copper sky and sea turn into wet, unblended oil strokes, as if the evening is being painted around the woman he holds like "another lot". It starts a painter's-materials arc: wet oil at the arrival (M1), varnish cracks at dinner (M3), pure pigment as she leaves (M4). In motion the strokes shimmer like heat haze. If Seedream paints the people too, reject the take: render a photographic plate and add the brushstrokes to the sky and sea in post (composites, not generations). KEEPS: the copper jetty, black-sand bay, storm front, seaplane, his flat palm on her waist with his eyes ahead (the "another lot" card, #082), Kira soft from behind watching, ref order kira/mila/jean. DROPS: the bronze figure and the M1jf nano edit, the "extremely long, thin bare legs", the black dress, and Jean-Marc's white linen (it moves to dinner).
shots.plain_english: The arrival again, with no statue: Mila in a faded-blue knit dress with healthy legs, Jean-Marc in emerald velvet and gold, and behind them the sky and sea turn to wet oil paint, from your line "the air thickens like oil paint".

She holds a burning match beside her wide-open eye, burned almost to her fingers; his fingertips rest on the pulse inside her wrist. No kiss. No text.

shots.prompt: Unretouched 35mm film still, 16:9, real skin, pores, sweat, muted film colour, grain; not painted, not HDR. Night, a black stone room, a carved Marquesan post; the only light is crimson and honey bars rising from low shutter slats, as if from underground. Close, from behind her left shoulder: the woman from the first reference image (grey-green eyes, glossy true-black wavy curly hair, never blue, faint pale healed scar through her left eyebrow, about 34) turns her face into the neck of the man from the second reference image (tanned, ash-blond hair tied back, golden stubble, pale blue eyes, about 47, devilishly handsome): left profile, eye open, unblinking, lips parted a breath from his skin, not touching, not a kiss, as if she has just said his name. Her black silk slip has fallen to the small of her back: bare back wet with sweat, her chest pressed to him, hidden from camera; her fist holds his open white linen collar. He stands utterly still, head back against the carving, throat bared, eyes open, one hand flat on her shoulder blade. One impossible light, treated as normal: where her breath falls on his throat lies a small pool of cool lilac-white dawn light, as through a frosted window, in a room lit only crimson. No text.
shots.other_reality: The frost, judged under the rule: ice growing on skin is matter laid on the body, in the same family as the rejected frozen drops, so it becomes light. Where her breath falls on his throat lies a small pool of cool lilac-white dawn light, as through a frosted window, in a room lit only crimson. This is "I am that other Coolness on your path" (#040).
